scenarios.name: first_sync_push
scenarios.description: Client pushes one entry on first sync, server has nothing
postconditions: Server MUST have entry c1 in its store
Server day file 2026-04-15.txt MUST contain the entry

scenarios.name: first_sync_pull
scenarios.description: Client has nothing, server has one entry
preconditions: Server has entry s1 with text 'Server note' and sync_log entry

scenarios.name: bidirectional_sync
scenarios.description: Both sides have entries, single sync merges them
preconditions: Server has entry s1 with sync_log
Client has entry c1 in local sync_log
postconditions: Server MUST have both s1 and c1
Client receives s1 in response entries

scenarios.name: no_sync_loop
scenarios.description: Second sync with same token returns nothing new

scenarios.name: deletion_tombstone
scenarios.description: Deleted entry appears as tombstone in sync
preconditions: Server had entry d1, then it was deleted
postconditions: Client MUST delete d1 from local index upon receiving this

validation_rules: Server MUST NOT return entries that the client just pushed in the same sync call
Server MUST skip client entries when server copy has newer updated_at
Client MUST store new_token and use it in the next sync
Entries with metadata._deleted=true are tombstones; client MUST delete locally
